summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases from July 13-17, 2026, as part of its existing buyback program announced February 17, 2026, authorizing up to EUR 1 billion in total repurchases. The filing details 165,000 shares bought on US venues and 62,762 on London venues at various prices, all of which will be cancelled. Goldman Sachs acted as counterparty. This is a routine disclosure of an ongoing capital return program, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer or issuer self-tender. No structural changes, premium above market, or strategic catalysts are present.
